title: A stability theorem for Berge Hamiltonian cycles under a minimum degree condition
summary: In this paper, we study extremal and stability problems for Berge Hamiltonian cycles in $r$-uniform hypergraphs under a minimum degree condition. Let $ g_r(n,t)=\binom{n-t}{r}+t\binom{t}{r-1}$, and let $t=t(k)$ be the unique integer satisfying $\binom{t-1}{r-1}<k\le \binom{t}{r-1}$. Using a sharp Pósa-type degree sequence theorem of Salia, we prove an extremal upper bound on the number of hyperedges in an $n$-vertex $r$-uniform hypergraph with minimum degree at least $k$ and with no Berge Hamiltonian cycle.
